title: Christmas Spirits (BBC)
paragraphs: A Golden Radio Hour collection of BBC Christmas-season supernatural and ghost dramas. The recordings come from different productions, so they are presented as a themed collection rather than one original series.

Curated preservation compilation of 22 unique BBC radio ghost, horror and supernatural items spanning 1962-2014. It is not one historical BBC series: objects originate in multiple series, readings, stand-alone plays, serials and later omnibus presentations.
The run breaks into several distinct periods: BBC Christmas supernatural preservation compilation (December 24, 1962 to December 20, 2014) on [[org|org.deepv2.f713a484394d0d32|BBC Radio]].

Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include Alec McCowen (performer), Charles Lefeaux (producer and radio adaptor), David Hunter (director), Sheila Grant (performer), Ann McKay (producer), Ballard Berkeley (performer), and Bernard Brown (performer).

The stories often return to Christmas ghost and supernatural story, holiday horror and uncanny experience, cross-series BBC preservation compilation, literary work adapted or read for radio, original BBC radio drama, and radio reading and narrated story.

The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes BBC Radio 4 Christmas Spirits strand, BBC Radio 5 The Woman in Black serial, Mysterious Circumstances source productions, and Fear on 4 Christmas horror contributions.
